title: Personal Efficiency Training Programme
quote: An incredibly valuable course resulting in an implementable personal action plan. The initial call and activity log provided an opportunity to reflect in advance of the classroom session and then the day long course was a much needed ‘step away’ moment and was both tailored and practical. Martin took time to focus on the group’s needs as well as each individual’s whilst taking us through the theory to better understand behavioural change. I would highly recommend this course.
author: Diane Cains
subject: Personal Efficiency
